rows.en: Our dream isn't over yet, you and me.
Reinforcements? What a nice surprise.
rows.notes: Whisper 'ureshii ko-san'; read as ureshii goosan (welcome miscalculation).

rows.en: Sound Force here. We're counting on you.
Not a bad rhythm.
You're doing whatever you please.
What the hell are you doing?!
We lost the rhythm, huh.
Everybody had a good groove today.
That was a good show.
Looks like we'll make today's show somehow.
We didn't make it. Now I'm just like Basara.
Being too careful got us into this mess.
Damn, out of time.
The operation failed. We're pulling out.
Looks like we played a terrible set.
Can't believe it came to this.
Sorry, but could you cover me with fire?
I'd appreciate some covering fire.
Fire from there and it'll set a good rhythm.
Sorry to trouble you, but go in for close combat!
Why not try close combat for a change?
Get out in front and stand out.
Hey! You're too reckless! Fall back!
Leave this to me.
Easy, calm down!
Go all out!
You can do it!
Formation Medley!
Sorry, but I'm picking up the tempo.
Let me cut loose a little.
Now for the best part!
Got it.
Roger.
Captain, don't get so fired up!
You're overdoing it, Captain.
Your groove is a bit off, Captain.
Told you so, Captain.
I never thought the captain would exit mid-show.
Damn! The captain's been shot down!
What a sound. No way I can fight this.
I give up. I never thought the Song Energy would be this strong.
Just how much Song Energy is this song putting out?
rows.notes: Whisper 'nan chiba song'; read as a quantity of Song Energy.

rows.en: As expected of you, Captain.
Nice rhythm, Captain.
Basara's got a great groove today!
Nice, Mylene! Keep it up!
I've got no complaint about teaming up with you, but...
just don't do anything that kills the groove.
Well, I guess so. Do it your way.
What a dangerous world it's become, huh?
All right, let's go. Ready?
Do it right. I'm counting on you.
This should be easy for you.
Show me that fire of yours.
Shall we hit them with a big one, too?
Don't die! I can't go through what happened back then again!
Let's make this the best show ever!
With you, I feel like we could do something huge.
That was the worst show, bar none.
I never thought it'd be this bad.
Looks like this duo breaks up after this one.
Let's keep working together.
That was rough, wasn't it?
We both had a rough time.
You're rough around the edges, but I think you're doing well.
You've got a pretty good sense for this.
Keep it up next time, too.
That was a great show! Glad I got to do it with you!
I knew you were special the moment I saw you, but this good? Wow.
A great show takes a great partner, right?
I admire your spirit of challenge, but I'd advise against it.
Please don't get shot down right in front of me.
I'll back you up as much as I can, but even I have limits.
Let's enjoy the show! I'm counting on you!
We should be able to handle an op like this easily.
The operation's about to start. Stay sharp.
You can do it. I guarantee it.
I wonder what kind of show this will be.
Just do it like you always do and you'll be fine. I'm counting on you.
